title: setswp
description: Transmission path settings and random teleportation at path points
body:
# Set up teleportation points and perform random teleportation.
## Added the /setswp command
Usage instructions：

1. Regional management command
   
   **/setswp add <region name>**:Create a new region
   
   **/setswp regions**:List all regions
   
   **/setswp list <region name>**:List the teleportation points for the specified region or all regions
   
2. Set up a teleportation point
   
   **/setswp set**:Set the default region teleport point (set at the player's current coordinates)
   
   **/setswp set <region name>**:Set the designated region transfer point (the region will be automatically created if it does not exist.It also set at the player's current coordinates)
3. Redion teleportation
   
   **/setswp tp**:Randomly teleport oneself at the teleportation point in the default area
   
   **/setswp tp <region name>**:Teleport yourself randomly at a teleport point within a specified region
   
   **/setswp tp @a**:Randomly teleport all players to a certain teleportation point within the default region
   
   **/setswp tp <region name> @a**:Randomly teleport all players to a certain teleportation point within the designated region
   
4. Regional Management
   
   **/setswp remove <index>**:Remove the default teleportation point of region
   
   **/setswp remove <index> <area name>**:Remove the teleportation points in the specified region
   
   **/setswp clear**:Remove all teleportation points from all regions

   **/setswp clear <region name>**:Remove the teleportation points in the specified region
   
5.
   **/setswp help**:Display help information
   
6. Notes for Attention
   The mod offers random teleportation instead of fixed-point teleportation.
   Suitable for use on PvP servers (for setting the battle location)
   
7. The file for the teleportation point records is located at: (your server path) \world\data\setswp_points.json
